totals.at_risk_rule: Per entry: largest single reduction among open findings, capped at the entry amount. Invoice: the larger of the per-entry sum and the largest invoice-level amount, capped at the sum of the lines.

findings.source_quote: We do not reimburse overhead such as word processing, overtime, postage and subscription databases.
findings.source_ref: Part D. Things we do not pay for, page 2
findings.explanation: This expense looks like an overhead item the client does not reimburse (expense code E103).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the expense from the bill.

findings.entry_narrative: Telephone conference with general counsel regarding hearing outcome
findings.source_quote: Record time in increments of 0.1 hour.
findings.source_ref: Part B. What your invoices should look like, page 1
findings.explanation: 0.75 hours is not a multiple of the 0.1 hour increment.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to restate the time in 0.1 hour increments from their own records.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft deposition notice for purchasing director
findings.source_quote: Each fee entry needs a task code and an activity code.
findings.source_ref: Part B. What your invoices should look like, page 1
findings.explanation: The entry has no task code.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the missing code. The timekeeper or billing staff should choose it; the check does not guess.

findings.entry_narrative: Prepare invoice backup for client auditor
findings.source_quote: We do not pay for clerical tasks or for time spent preparing, reviewing or correcting invoices.
findings.source_ref: Part D. Things we do not pay for, page 2
findings.explanation: The narrative contains "Prepare invoice", which is on this client's list of non-billable invoice prep work.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entry off the bill, or ask the timekeeper whether the description is accurate.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft opposition to motion to transfer venue; telephone conference with client regarding declaration; review exhibits for filing
findings.source_quote: Do not block bill: an entry exceeding 1.0 hour must describe a single task.
findings.source_ref: Part B. What your invoices should look like, page 1
findings.explanation: The narrative appears to describe 3 tasks under one time total of 2.7 hours.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to enter each task on its own line with its own time. Tasks the check detected: (1) Draft opposition to motion to transfer venue. (2) telephone conference with client regarding declaration. (3) review exhibits for filing. The tool does not know how the time divides between them and does not rewrite the narrative.

findings.entry_narrative: Research enforceability of forum selection clauses in supply agreements
findings.source_quote: We need 60 days written notice before any rate increase applies to our matters.
findings.explanation: Billed at $465.00 an hour; the last billed rate was $440.00. Notice was given on 2026-08-20, so the new rate applies from 2026-10-19.
findings.suggested_fix: Bill this entry at the prior rate, or record the notice the client received.

findings.source_quote: We cannot pay for entries that are too generic to evaluate, for example "work on discovery" or "attention to matter".
findings.source_ref: Part B. What your invoices should look like, page 1
findings.explanation: The description does not say what was done. It is only "Work on discovery", with no subject or purpose.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to say what was reviewed or done and for what purpose. Do not fill this in for them.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft index of exhibits for transfer hearing
findings.source_quote: Bill at the rates on the agreed rate card and no higher.
findings.explanation: Billed at $255.00 an hour. The approved rate for this timekeeper is $240.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the rate to the approved rate card, or attach the client's approval of the higher rate.

findings.source_quote: Pass third-party costs through at cost, without mark-up.
findings.source_ref: Part D. Things we do not pay for, page 2
findings.explanation: Billed at $230.00; the recorded cost is $200.00.

findings.entry_narrative: Attend hearing on motion to transfer venue
findings.source_quote: We expect lean staffing, and we will pay for no more than 2 of your lawyers at any hearing, deposition or mediation.
findings.source_ref: Part A. How we expect matters to be staffed, page 1
findings.explanation: 3 timekeepers billed for attending a hearing on 2026-10-15. The limit is 2. The check keeps the highest-rate attendee(s) and flags the rest; that choice is an assumption.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide which attendance to bill, or record the client's approval of the additional attendee.

findings.suggested_fix: Bill this entry at the prior rate, or record the notice the client received.

findings.entry_narrative: Research transfer factors applied in recent district decisions
findings.rule_label: Research needs approval above a limit
findings.source_quote: Please obtain our approval before spending more than 5 hours on legal research for a matter.
findings.source_ref: Part A. How we expect matters to be staffed, page 1
findings.explanation: Research on this invoice reaches 5.7 hours with this entry. The limit without approval is 5 hours; 0.7 hours of this entry fall over it.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client to approve the research, or hold the excess time. Research billed on earlier invoices is not counted here.
findings.note: Waiver W-002 expired on 2026-09-30 and does not cover this work.

summary: Draft invoice INV-O-3001 for Ostervane Industrial Holdings (matter OIH-LIT-088) totals $20,655.25 across 31 lines. The check ran 13 confirmed client rules plus the arithmetic checks. It found 12 open findings on 11 lines: 4 will likely be rejected, 8 likely reduced and 0 for review. The amount at risk is $4,800.00, or 23.2% of the invoice, counting each line once at its largest single reduction. The most frequent issue is rate increase without notice (2 findings). Every finding is a prompt for review; nothing on the bill has been changed.
